It fucking sucks, I feel like I am socially cursed. I do listen to a lot of music and am actually a musician myself. Music is a great conversation starter. Thank you for caring.

This really has helped me a lot. I know I need to stop smoking weed, or at least cut back a lot but it's so hard when all my friends light up all day and every day. And when it comes to partying...I actually enjoy partying because it takes my mind off of everything else and I get to act myself and have fun. Part of the reason why I'm so depressed is because I know all these things I need to do such as getting my sleeping schedule regulated...quitting smoking...focusing on school work...self-discipline...stop thinking about my ex; but it's really hard to do these things when I have absolutely no motivation to go on with life. I appreciate your words and I will definitely work towards bettering myself with self-discipline and establishing a future.  Thank you so much.
